title: Sweet Magnolias
overview: Lifelong friends Maddie, Helen and Dana Sue lift each other up as they juggle relationships, family and careers in the small Southern town of Serenity.

episodes.name: Pour It Out
episodes.overview: Amid prying eyes, Maddie tries to move on from Bill's fall from grace. Dana Sue deals with problems in her kitchen. Helen makes a life-altering purchase.
episodes.plot: Maddie and Bill Townsend are getting a divorce, and are having a disagreement about who is going to keep the house. Luckily for Maddie, Helen, her best friend and divorce lawyer helps her keep the house. Meanwhile, their other best friend, Dana Sue is seen firing her assistant, Brad, at her restaurant, because of stolen whiskey. She has a fight with her daughter, Annie, because Annie's behavior towards the town and its people is not what Dana Sue expected. At the same time, Tyler, Maddie and Bill's eldest son is going through an emotional phase because of his parents' divorce and also talks about giving up on his dream of becoming a baseball player. Dana Sue and Helen get an idea of opening their own spa, with Maddie managing it, but it is too overwhelming for Maddie.

episodes.name: A United Front
episodes.overview: Maddie confers with Coach Cal about Tyler's struggles on and off the baseball field, and Helen works to put a devastated family back together.

episodes.name: Give Drink to the Thirsty
episodes.overview: While delays plague the trio's renovation plans, Maddie strikes a deal with Bill, Dana Sue stresses out over work and home, and Kyle opens up to Noreen.

episodes.name: Lay It All Down
episodes.overview: The town's tongues start wagging over Maddie's new friend, Dana Sue suffers a health scare, and Helen takes a legal threat personally.

episodes.name: Dance First, Think Later
episodes.overview: Mother Nature, a clumsy contractor and Maddie's longtime rival conspire to throw the spa's big opening into chaos. Tyler helps Annie out of a jam.

episodes.name: All Best Intentions
episodes.overview: Maddie worries about prying eyes when she's with Cal, a humiliated Annie feels betrayed by Tyler, and Bill surprises the kids with a special request.

episodes.name: Hold My Hand
episodes.overview: Maddie's coziness with Cal causes complications, Helen fights for a mock trial student, Noreen receives a welcome visitor, and Erik bonds with Isaac.

episodes.name: What Fools These Mortals Be
episodes.overview: As Bill makes a series of bad decisions that impact those closest to him, Noreen attends Kyle's play and Maddie takes a big step forward with Cal.

episodes.name: Where You Find Me
episodes.overview: On the morning of the mock trial, Kyle's behavior worries everyone. Meanwhile, Dana Sue sparks a connection with a handsome farmer.

episodes.name: Storms and Rainbows
episodes.overview: As prom night approaches, Maddie comes to a decision about Cal, Dana Sue scrambles to secure her future, and Helen calls an emergency margarita session.
episodes.plot: Helen and Ryan decide to break up as he refuses to have children. Bill tries to become a better father for his children. CeCe asks Ty to prom. Kyle and Annie's plan to spend the prom night together is broken when Annie decides to go to prom with Simon, and Kyle decides to spend the evening with Nellie at Lewis' house. Dana Sue's silent partner in Sullivan's needs her to buy him out, and she is forced to call Ronnie so that they can officially divorce. A scouter and longtime friend of Cal's tries recruiting Ty, which leads to a fight between Maddie and Cal. Jackson and his friends, including Ty, Annie, and Simon, crash Kyle and Nellie's party. Isaac asks Dana Sue if she is his mother. Bill asks Maddie to take him back. Jackson provokes a fight with CeCe and Ty, and Kyle intervenes. Ty throws him off, upsetting Kyle, who runs out of the house. The Magnolias and Bill are rushed to the flipped-over car of Ty. Unconscious Kyle is taken onto a stretcher, but the paramedics still do not know who the passenger is, or if they're alive.

episodes.name: Casseroles and Casualties
episodes.overview: In the waiting room, the families gather for news from the doctors, and Ty's plans for the season change. Over margaritas, Helen shares an announcement.
episodes.plot: The Magnolias and Bill are waiting in the hospital for Kyle's diagnosis, and they discover the passenger was Nellie, who only has minor lacerations. Ty, Annie and Jackson arrive at the hospital, and the Lewises blame Jackson for everything. Annie defends him, causing an argument between the parents. Jackson and Ty get into a physical fight resulting in Ty dislocating his shoulder. Kyle wakes up but must remain in hospital. Bill offers to stay with him as Maddie takes Ty home to rest. Ty cries himself to sleep as he realises that he cannot play for the remainder of the season, possibly losing his chances at playing pro. Cal and Maddie make up, and Maddie informs Bill she does not want to get back together. Dana Sue storms out from a margarita night after she defends Annie. Helen tells Maddie she is pregnant.

episodes.name: So Much to Say
episodes.overview: Helen helps Isaac in his search for answers, Dana Sue's restaurant hits a financial hiccup, and Maddie tries to find out what happened with her son.
episodes.plot: With Ty's injury the bulldogs lose their championship. Cal's anger begins to surface.

episodes.name: The More Things Change
episodes.overview: While Coach Cal and Ty work through disappointments, a new kind of heartbreak hits Helen, and Dana Sue gets a late-night visitor on her front porch.

episodes.name: Walk of Faith
episodes.overview: The questions keep coming as Maddie investigates the lot behind the spa and Helen looks for clues in what Isaac's birth mother left behind.

episodes.name: Great Expectations
episodes.overview: Dana Sue's relationships become the talk of Serenity social media. Maddie uncovers who's behind the town's parking problem — bless their hearts.

episodes.name: Find It in Your Heart
episodes.overview: When the mayor won't see them, the Magnolias take their plans to the next level. At karaoke, Helen and Erik give the town something to talk about.

episodes.name: Fragile Things
episodes.overview: New beginnings abound as Serenity welcomes Noreen's baby, Isaac's birth mother tells him her whole story, and Erik reveals his painful past to Helen.

episodes.name: The Rules of the Game
episodes.overview: As the recall petition quickly picks up steam, Maddie and Cal attend a black-tie charity fundraiser and Ronnie presses Dana Sue to make up her mind.

episodes.name: Dear Heart
episodes.overview: Friends gather to plan a celebration of life. Meanwhile, counseling is off to a rocky start for Ronnie and Dana Sue, and Isaac meets his birth father.

episodes.name: If Thou Wilt, Remember
episodes.overview: More than margaritas are shaken up as Cal's past resurfaces, an unsavory acquaintance returns to Serenity, and Helen faces a life-changing decision.
episodes.plot: Dana Sue, Maddie and Cal talk in Sullivan's about Cal's recent firing as Coach. Cal tries to protect Maddie when crazed fan enters the kitchen, Cal is arrested after the fan attempts to jump Maddie. Meanwhile Dana Sue discovers Miss Frances had left her a surprising gift. Helen is taken by surprise when Ryan returns to town and proposes.

episodes.name: Meaning to Tell You
episodes.overview: After the incident at the restaurant, an unlikely ally offers to help Cal. Helen shares her painful secret and Maddie grills Ty about a rumor.
episodes.plot: Helen gets Cal out on bail, the magnolias meet at Helens to regroup. Cal is beside himself unable to fathom how he lost control, especially in front on Maddie. Maddie wants to help him, but he pulls away. Dana Sue tells Ronnie about the cheque and they discuss about the woman vandalizing Sullivans delivery trucks. It's Ronnie's sister, Kathy, she's back and ready for vengeance. Ty visits Cal and berates him for embarrassing his mother. Helen breaks up with Eric and tells Ryan that they should take things slow and try again. she hands him back the engagement ring.

episodes.name: Meet Me Where I Am
episodes.overview: Erik opens up to Isaac while Helen ponders her future. Over margaritas, Maddie reveals the deal she made with Cal. Dana Sue and Ronnie plan a party.

episodes.name: The Searchers
episodes.overview: The competition heats up and the friendly trash talk flies as Serenity gathers for the Forager Festival. A vengeful Kathy cooks up a couple of schemes.

episodes.name: Be Bold
episodes.overview: Peggy digs into the mayor's activities after his announcement. Dana Sue learns the reason behind Miss Frances' gift. Helen gives CeCe another option.

episodes.name: On This Foundation
episodes.overview: Mary Vaughn drops a bombshell on Bill and Kyle. Annie has the shindig of her dreams — until a party crasher arrives. Erik meets a Serenity newcomer.

episodes.name: And a Star to Steer Her By
episodes.overview: Friends rally around Harlan after a crisis. Maddie and Dana Sue hire an esthetician. While at odds with the Magnolias, Helen receives heartbreaking news.

episodes.name: Somebody I'm Longing to See
episodes.overview: A devastated Helen finds comfort in her family away from Serenity. Bill hopes to be more involved in Rebecca's life. Dana Sue walks into a total mess.

episodes.name: Beat Me at My Own Game
episodes.overview: Ronnie gives Kathy what she wants, but it comes at a steep price. Erik meets Jeremy and comes to a realization. The kids rally to restore a playground.

episodes.name: A Game of Telephone
episodes.overview: An ex brings tensions and more to the table during a dinner with Maddie and Cal. Kyle deals with a secret admirer. Dana Sue has a change of party plans.

episodes.name: Save My Place
episodes.overview: Erik makes a decision about his future. Miss Paula announces her new plan. The town turns out to celebrate a happy couple, but an unwanted guest appears.

episodes.name: The Other Side of the Veil
episodes.overview: Bubbly in hand, the Magnolias toast to the future. The restaurant hosts an elegant event, and a festive Halloween party conjures up bewitching surprises.

episodes.name: Practical Dreams
episodes.overview: Helen navigates a deepening crisis, while Dana Sue challenges her students to spread their culinary wings. An unexpected visitor brings important news.

episodes.name: Abundant Grace
episodes.overview: The Magnolias come together after a personal tragedy. Kyle's online hobby wins him new popularity, and a life-changing secret comes to light.

episodes.name: How Great Thou Art
episodes.overview: The Townsend kids process a sudden revelation. Maddie asserts her boundaries at home, while Helen helps the mayor get ahead of the town's rumor mill.

episodes.name: True North
episodes.overview: Torn between duty and desire, Ty follows his heart. Serenity hunkers down as a massive storm makes landfall. Erik risks everything in the name of love.

episodes.name: Ring That Bell
episodes.overview: Cal and the restaurant staff scramble to feed the town. A viral video puts Maddie in the spotlight. Helen kisses and tells with an extra-spicy story.

episodes.name: Hide and Seek
episodes.overview: When the Sentinel publishes a hurtful article, Helen's damage control pours fuel on the fire. Back from Ohio, Isaac breaks bread with the Townsends.

episodes.name: Walls and Doors
episodes.overview: Ronnie's behavior worries Dana Sue. Erik reveals his private passion. A new generation of Magnolias hold their first meeting — minus the margaritas.

episodes.name: Dance Your Sugarplum Off
episodes.overview: Cherished holiday traditions, both old and new, brighten the Christmas season for all. Maddie's recent news exposure yields an adventurous opportunity.

episodes.name: Do Not Be Afraid
episodes.overview: Serenity gathers for its annual festival. As relationships blossom and new plans abound, the Magnolias ponder the next chapter in their evolving stories.

episodes.name: The Magnolias Take Manhattan
episodes.overview: Six months after Maddie's move, the Magnolias take a bite out of the Big Apple — and wash it down with margaritas.

episodes.name: Bigger and Brighter
episodes.overview: As Maddie and Cal start new chapters, Dana Sue and Ronnie find themselves on different pages. Helen dusts off an old playbook for her dream wedding.

episodes.name: Never Stop Graduating
episodes.overview: Maddie helps Kyle and company tame a theatrical crisis. Helen gets an unwelcome glimpse of the "Whitley Way." Annie receives bittersweet news from afar.

episodes.name: Swing for the Fences
episodes.overview: The Magnolias shake their pompoms as the Bulldogs take the field for the annual alumni game. Shopping for bridesmaid dresses unearths deep emotions.

episodes.name: Aim Big
episodes.overview: An unexpected opportunity for Cal tests Maddie's faith in the future. Annie's heart is pulled in two directions. Old wounds resurface for Helen and Erik.

episodes.name: Smoke and Mirrors
episodes.overview: A town tradition proves food and fellowship can brighten the darkest days. Kyle and Lily clash with a co-star. Isaac learns love can thrive off-script.

episodes.name: Same Sky
episodes.overview: A whimsical bridal shower and a brain-teasing bachelor party honor the soon-to-be newlyweds — as a shocking secret shakes another couple's foundation.

episodes.name: Everyday, Every Day
episodes.overview: The Magnolias bring their sparkle to Savannah for a whirlwind bachelorette weekend. Back in Serenity, the Mini Magnolias help Annie narrow the field.

episodes.name: Common Language
episodes.overview: The Magnolias unveil their bold new vision at the revived Art Walk. A face from Cal's past raises uncertainty. Tensions simmer as the Whitleys arrive.

episodes.name: Come Home
episodes.overview: On Helen's wedding day, Maddie and Dana Sue raise a toast to hope, healing, heartbreak and the enduring bonds of friendship.
